name: Burning
title: Burning
text:
Burning will apply a Burning aura, which appears as an animated version of the Pyro aura and will coexist with the underlying Pyro and Dendro auras. The Dendro aura will be steadily consumed while burning. The Burning state requires both the Burning and Dendro auras to maintain, and will end if one of them is depleted.
For the purposes of effects that are triggered by elemental reactions such as Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City and Nahida's Seeds of Skandha, applying Pyro or Dendro to refresh Burning aura is not considered triggering Burning.
Burning cannot damage off-field characters. Switching to a different character while affected by Burning will temporarily pause the DoT ticks, but the Dendro consumption will continue. If the affected character becomes the active character again while still affected by Dendro, they will resume taking DMG.

## Environment
Burning can be inflicted on  objects by applying  to them. Burning can also be inflicted on  objects, such as lit bonfires and stoves, by applying  to them. Units that are Burning will also spread fire to combustible objects that they touch such as grass.
In the open world, grass, haystacks, shrubs, small trees, crates, and barrels are all  objects. After being burned, grass will be charred and cannot be burned again until the area resets, while shrubs and small trees will be temporarily destroyed.
The amount of  dealt by Burning objects will vary:
* Burning grass DMG will scale with the grass's own level.
* Burning bushes will not deal DMG at all, but will still apply .
* Burning inflicted on any other objects will deal DMG based on the stats of the character who triggered the reaction.
Although Tri-Lakshana Creatures that are not enemies are  objects and react normally with  and  to produce the Bloom and Quicken reactions, they do not react normally with . Applying  to them immediately removes their Dendro status and does not cause the Burning reaction.
